source.original_text:
Let \(n\ge3\), \(\kappa\ge4\), and let \(\mu\) be normalized Borel Haar probability on the full real orthogonal group. Set \(A_O= rac{\kappa+1}{2}I_n- rac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^	op)\), \(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\), and \(
u_\pm=2\mu|_{\{\det O=\pm1\}}\). The actual Gaussian family \(O\mapsto\gamma_O\) is measurable as a map into Borel measures on Euclidean \(\mathbb R^n\). Its actual mixtures \(P_\pm=\int\gamma_O\,d
u_\pm(O)\) are probability measures, and for every Borel set \(B\), \(P_\pm(B)=\int\gamma_O(B)\,d
u_\pm(O)\). All family measurability and probability-construction facts are conclusions. The source leaves these well-definedness details implicit; product targets, bounded-test expectation transport and the total-variation interpretation remain separate.

∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ),
    let μ := (Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))
    let νpos := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = 1}
    let νneg := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1}
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))⁻¹
    Measurable γ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure (νpos.bind γ) ∧
      IsProbabilityMeasure (νneg.bind γ) ∧
      (∀ B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), MeasurableSet B →
        (νpos.bind γ) B = ∫⁻ O, γ O B ∂νpos) ∧
      (∀ B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), MeasurableSet B →
        (νneg.bind γ) B = ∫⁻ O, γ O B ∂νneg)

blind_reconstruction.text: For every natural number n with 3 ≤ n and every real number κ with 4 ≤ κ, let G = O(n, ℝ), let μ be the normalized Haar Borel probability measure on the full group G, and define νpos = 2 · (μ restricted to {O ∈ G : det O = 1}) and νneg = 2 · (μ restricted to {O ∈ G : det O = −1}). For O ∈ G, set Aκ(O) = ((κ + 1)/2) I − ((κ − 1)/4)(O + Oᵀ), and define γ(O) to be the centered multivariate Gaussian probability measure on ℝⁿ with covariance Aκ(O)⁻¹. Then γ is measurable as a map from G to the space of Borel measures on ℝⁿ, equipped with the sigma algebra generated by evaluation on Borel sets. The actual mixtures νpos.bind γ and νneg.bind γ, where ν.bind γ = join(map γ ν), are both probability measures. Moreover, for every Borel set B ⊆ ℝⁿ, (νpos.bind γ)(B) = ∫⁻_G γ(O)(B) dνpos(O), and for every Borel set B ⊆ ℝⁿ, (νneg.bind γ)(B) = ∫⁻_G γ(O)(B) dνneg(O).

import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.GaussianLawDensity
import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.DeterminantComponents
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.ProbabilityMeasure

/-!
# Actual determinant-conditioned Gaussian mixture laws

Zhou--Suzuki arXiv:2610.20492v1, Section 3.1 single-block definition before Eq6,
Section2 determinant priors and AppendixB2.2. The source leaves measurable-family
and probability-construction bookkeeping implicit. Those producers are proved
here for the actual Gaussian constructor, using the identical law-density and
component-prior nodes. Product targets, H-to-TV and main bounds are separate.
-/

open Matrix MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ENNReal
open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.OrthogonalHaar
open AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.DeterminantFamily
open AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.GaussianLawDensity
open AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.DeterminantComponents

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.GaussianMixtureLaws

theorem actual_mixture_laws {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) :
    let μ := orthogonalHaar n
    let νpos := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = 1}
    let νneg := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1}
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
    Measurable γ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure (νpos.bind γ) ∧
      IsProbabilityMeasure (νneg.bind γ) ∧
      (∀ B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), MeasurableSet B →
        (νpos.bind γ) B = ∫⁻ O, γ O B ∂νpos) ∧
      (∀ B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), MeasurableSet B →
        (νneg.bind γ) B = ∫⁻ O, γ O B ∂νneg) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let G := Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)
  let μ := orthogonalHaar n
  let νpos := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
    {O : G | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = 1}
  let νneg := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
    {O : G | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1}
  let γ : G → Measure E := fun O =>
    multivariateGaussian (0 : E) (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
  let p : G → E → ℝ := fun O x =>
    Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det / (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
      Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
  have hAc : Continuous (fun O : G => singleBlockPrecision κ O) := by
    unfold singleBlockPrecision
    exact continuous_const.sub
      ((continuous_subtype_val.add continuous_subtype_val.matrix_transpose).const_smul ((κ - 1) / 4))
  have hpc : Continuous (fun z : G × E => p z.1 z.2) := by
    dsimp only [p, E]
    fun_prop
  have hpm : Measurable (Function.uncurry (fun O x => ENNReal.ofReal (p O x))) :=
    ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp hpc.measurable
  have hd : γ = fun O => (volume : Measure E).withDensity
      (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (p O x)) := by
    funext O
    exact gaussian_law_eq_density hn hκ O
  have hm : Measurable γ := by
    rw [hd]
    exact measurable_withDensity hpm
  have hpriors := component_probabilities (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn)
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure νpos := hpriors.2.2.1
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure νneg := hpriors.2.2.2
  have hprob (O : G) : IsProbabilityMeasure (γ O) := by
    dsimp [γ]
    infer_instance
  refine ⟨hm, isProbabilityMeasure_bind hm.aemeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hprob),
    isProbabilityMeasure_bind hm.aemeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hprob), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro B hB
    exact Measure.bind_apply hB hm.aemeasurable
  · intro B hB
    exact Measure.bind_apply hB hm.aemeasurable

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.GaussianMixtureLaws

steps.title: Make the density jointly measurable
steps.text: The precision depends continuously on \(O\). The displayed density is continuous jointly in \((O,x)\), so its nonnegative extended-real form is measurable.
steps.lean: Local hAc and hpc prove continuity for the exact literal precision/density; hpm applies ENNReal.measurable_ofReal. No density measurability premise is added.

steps.title: Identify the actual measurable Gaussian family
steps.text: Use the existing exact law-density identity for every \(O\), at the unchanged source parameters. Measurability of measures with a jointly measurable density then gives measurability of the actual Gaussian family.
steps.lean: The proof calls GaussianLawDensity.gaussian_law_eq_density hn hκ O, whose internal SPD proof uses the source precision bounds, then the exact Mathlib measurable_withDensity. The conclusion concerns the actual multivariateGaussian constructor.

steps.title: Use the normalized determinant priors
steps.text: The existing half-mass theorem supplies the two literal prior probability laws. The same full Haar law is retained throughout.
steps.lean: DeterminantComponents.component_probabilities is applied at the internally derived positive dimension. Its actual2*restriction probability conclusions are installed, not supplied by the caller.

steps.title: Construct genuine probability mixtures
steps.text: Mix the same measurable Gaussian family against each probability prior. Every component Gaussian has total mass one, so both resulting measures have total mass one.
steps.lean: The actual measures are νpos.bind γ and νneg.bind γ, where bind is join of map. isProbabilityMeasure_bind consumes the proved family measurability, exact prior probabilities and actual Gaussian probability instances. No replacement density-only law or fallback kernel is defined.

steps.title: Evaluate every Borel event
steps.text: For any Borel event, the value of each actual mixture equals the corresponding average of component Gaussian probabilities. This identifies the source mixture laws; bounded-test expectation transport remains a separate step.
steps.lean: Both Measure.bind_apply calls use the measurable family already proved above. B is universally quantified in the conclusion; its Borel condition is the ordinary evaluation domain, not an additional theorem-level regularity assumption.
